messages:
Sam: Heads-up — main CI just turned red after that PR merge (PR #4321). Smoke suite failing in the gateway step with 502s. Job: build/main/smoke/gateway #4827. Anyone available to grab this?
ci-bot: [ALERT] build/main/smoke/gateway #4827 failed. Failed step: gateway-integration. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/4827
Anita: On it, pulling the logs now.
Jorge: I can take a look if no one else is oncall. Was that the router middleware change? cc @Anita
Sam: Yes — I landed a small host/header rewrite in router service (commit b3f5d9). Can revert quick if it's the culprit.
Anita: Early glance -> lots of upstream connection resets to 10.2.3.4:8080. Looks like 502 from envoy.
Anita: ```
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] gateway: 502 Bad Gateway from upstream 10.2.3.4:8080
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"gateway/handler.py\", line 214, in handle
    resp = upstream.request(req)
  File \"gateway/upstream.py\", line 88, in request
    raise ConnectionResetError(\"connection reset by peer\")
ConnectionResetError: connection reset by peer
```
Jorge: Could be a deploy race — deploy-bot shows a user-backend rollout ~5m ago. @ci-bot any infra diffs around that time?
deploy-bot: Deployed service 'user-backend' to cluster-prod-4 5 minutes ago. Rollout ID dl-9981. See https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollouts/dl-9981
Anita: The failing requests have X-Host: svc-router-v2 header. Sam, did the router change rewrite host header to svc-router-v2?
Sam: Yep — added rewrite for /internal/* to use svc-router-v2 for routing experiments. Possible we sent traffic to a canary backend that wasn't ready. I'll prepare a revert PR if we confirm.
Jorge: Quick triage steps: rerun job first to rule out flake. @Anita can you trigger a rerun, or should we escalate?
Anita: Triggering rerun now. ci-bot please rerun job 4827.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: build/main/smoke/gateway #4827.rerun1 — started.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: FAILED — same ConnectionResetError in gateway.
Sam: OK not a transient flake. I'll open a revert PR for the header rewrite.
Jorge: That seems safest. If revert is fast we can unbreak main and follow up with a proper canary. Assign to Sam.
Sam: Opening revert now — https://git.redwood.internal/repo/routers/commit/undo-b3f5d9 (PR: https://git.redwood.internal/pulls/1234). Pinging eng-oncall and platform.
Anita: :thumbsup: I'll hold canary traffic changes on the console and monitor.
Jorge: Filing an incident to track impact and remediation (INC-2026-081). Assign eng-oncall + platform.
incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-081: "Gateway 502s after router header rewrite" — https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-081
Sam: Revert PR merged (merged at commit c4d9a8). Kicking off smoke rerun.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: build/main/smoke/gateway #4827.rerun2 — started.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: PASSED.
Sam: Main is green again. Closing the incident. Thanks for the fast help everyone.
Jorge: Nice job. Leaving notes in the PR about canary gating.
Anita: Will follow up with a quick postmortem bullet list in the incident.
ci-bot: Incident INC-2026-081 marked resolved.
